seo.title: Methodology — de Harven Recruitment
seo.description: A rigorous, structured recruitment process: in-depth needs analysis, targeted sourcing, competency-based assessment, and thorough background verification.

hero.title: A rigorous, structured process
hero.body: Our recruitment methodology is based on a rigorous and structured process that begins with an in-depth analysis of our clients' needs, followed by targeted sourcing strategies, precise competency-based assessments, and thorough background verification.

timeline.title: Needs Analysis
timeline.body: An in-depth analysis of the client's needs — the role, the team, the culture, and the strategic objectives behind the hire.

timeline.title: Sourcing Strategy
timeline.body: Targeted sourcing strategies built around the specific profile, market, and industry rather than a generic candidate pool.

timeline.title: Competency-Based Assessment
timeline.body: Precise, standardised evaluation criteria applied consistently across every candidate under consideration.

timeline.title: Background Verification
timeline.body: Thorough verification to ensure reliability and alignment before any profile is presented to the client.

timeline.title: Onboarding Alignment
timeline.body: Transparent communication through to final onboarding, ensuring full alignment with the organisation's culture and objectives.

methodology.principlesTitle: What stays constant at every stage

principles.title: Transparent communication
principles.body: Clients and candidates are kept informed at every stage — no black boxes.

principles.title: Standardised evaluation
principles.body: The same rigorous criteria are applied consistently, regardless of role or seniority.

principles.title: Cultural alignment
principles.body: Full alignment with the organisation's culture and strategic objectives, not just the CV.

principles.title: Long-term fit
principles.body: We optimise for reliable, long-term talent solutions — not the fastest possible placement.

seo.title: About — Pierre de Harven | de Harven Recruitment
seo.description: Pierre de Harven founded de Harven Recruitment in 2024 after more than a decade in executive search and recruitment across Belgium and Europe.

bio: Pierre currently leads the firm, overseeing strategic recruitment assignments across the private sector as well as for public and institutional organisations. His work focuses on identifying and securing high-calibre talent in sectors where exceptional profiles are often in short supply.

After spending several years within renowned executive search firms — including Mercuri Urval and Hudson — and managing key recruitment mandates for Danaher Corporation (Fortune 500) in the biotechnology and life sciences sectors, he chose to establish his own practice to meet growing market demand for specialised, high-quality recruitment expertise.

He holds degrees in Law and International Relations from the Université libre de Bruxelles. A fluent speaker of French, English, and Italian, he operates across Europe with particularly extensive experience in the Belgian market.

seo.title: Privacy Policy — de Harven Recruitment
seo.description: How de Harven Recruitment collects, uses, and protects personal data submitted through this website.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data de Harven Recruitment collects through this website, why, and how you can exercise your rights over it. It applies to the contact form and newsletter sign-up on this site.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: The data controller is Pierre de Harven, operating as de Harven Recruitment, based in Oliena (NU), Italy. For any question about this policy or your data, contact deharvenpierre@gmail.com.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Through the contact form: first name, last name, email address, optional phone number, whether you are a company or a candidate, and the message you write. Through the newsletter sign-up: your email address and your consent to be contacted. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies on this site, and no data is collected beyond what you actively submit.

sections.title: Why we process it
sections.body: Solely to respond to your enquiry, evaluate a potential recruitment match, or send the newsletter updates you asked for. Your submission is delivered by email to Pierre de Harven; it is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on your consent, given when you submit the form or tick the newsletter checkbox, and on our legitimate interest in responding to business and candidate enquiries.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Personal data submitted through this site is kept only as long as necessary to handle your enquiry or, for candidates, to consider you for relevant opportunities — and is deleted on request at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your data, and to withdraw consent or object to processing at any time. To exercise any of these rights, email deharvenpierre@gmail.com.

sections.title: A note on this document
sections.body: This is a plain-language, factual description of how this specific website handles data — it is not a substitute for independent legal advice, and will be reviewed periodically as the business evolves.
